C0=hd0, C+=bc12, C-=ac21
is even, hence exactly one of the three macro contents
  G0=C+C-, G1=C-C0, G2=C+C0
is odd.


For
  W0±=UV±eR,
  W1±=zV±ex,
  W2±=zU±ey,
the three retained primitive macro Euclid parity bits epsilon_j satisfy
  epsilon0+epsilon1+epsilon2 even.
Together with G0G1G2=(C0C+C-)^2 this yields:
for every (sigma0,sigma1,sigma2) in {-,+}^3,
  W0^sigma0 W1^sigma1 W2^sigma2
is an exact positive integer square.


FULL_SQUAREFREE_PACKET_CLOSURE:
κj=sf(Wj-) satisfy κ0κ1κ2=square including prime2. Define
  D-=gcd(κ0,κ1), D+=gcd(κ0,κ2), D0=gcd(κ1,κ2).
Then D0,D+,D- are pairwise coprime squarefree and
  κ0=D+D-, κ1=D-D0, κ2=D+D0.
Their odd parts are the229BI packet triangle; the prime2 is canonically routed at the scalar-gap level only.


ARCHIMEDEAN_ORDER:
  W0-=UV-eR < min(zV-ex,zU-ey),
and
  sign((zV-ex)-(zU-ey))=sign(y-x).


CURRENT_NEW_INTERNAL_INTERFACE=FULL_MACRO_GAP_SQUARE_PRODUCT_OCCUPANCY:
count the realized physical ordered scalar image with exact R-height/selector equations,
  W0<min(W1,W2),
  W0W1W2=square,
  sf_odd(W0)>0.5 B^(1/3-delta),
and the full squarefree packet triangle above.


CURRENT_METHOD_FIREWALL:
Do not charge the odd square-product relation as an independent sieve condition on top of229BI/BJ; its odd support is the same macro-content triangle. The new information is full 2-adic synchronization plus a global integer-square relation and archimedean ordering.

  J1=zV-yR,
  J2=zU-xR.

  2J1=lambda_y S_y,
  2J2=lambda_x S_x

  sf(lambda_e lambda_y lambda_x M_e M_y M_x)=2
with

  (q2,r2,s2;A2,B2;L2,P2;G2)=(x,y,e;z,U;xR,zU;gcd(xR,ey)),
define
  lambda_j=A_j+B_j-R-q_j,
  Sigma_j=q_j+A_j+B_j+R,
  M_j=q_j+A_j+B_j-R,
  N_j=R+A_j+B_j-q_j.
Then
  lambda_j Sigma_j=2(P_j-L_j),
  M_j N_j=2(P_j+L_j),
  lambda_j M_j=2(R-A_j)(R-B_j),
  M_j-lambda_j=2q_j.


Define
  Q_j^-=gcd_odd(L_j,lambda_j), Q_j^+=gcd_odd(L_j,Sigma_j),
  P_j^-=gcd_odd(L_j,M_j),      P_j^+=gcd_odd(L_j,N_j).
The common-gcd nuisances are supported on d0^2,b^2,a^2 for j=0,1,2 and are coprime to L_j. Exact raw matching gives
  Q_j^-Q_j^+=P_j^-P_j^+=(G_j)_odd,
with each displayed pair coprime. The residual squareclass nuisance is trivial, hence
  O(lambda_j)=Q_j^- square,
  O(Sigma_j)=Q_j^+ square,
  O(M_j)=P_j^- square,
  O(N_j)=P_j^+ square.
Equivalently each of the twelve forms is eta*exact raw packet*square with eta in {1,2}. The e-base j=0 case is retained229AU/AV; j=1,2 are the new symmetric completions enabled by229BL.


HARD-REMAINDER REFINEMENT:
On the229BL remainder where all three outer pair products exceed T,
  xy>R sqrt(T), ex>R sqrt(T), ey>R sqrt(T),
so
  min(e,x,y)>sqrt(T),
  at least two of e,x,y exceed R^(1/2)T^(1/4),
  exy>R^(3/2)T^(3/4).
Also every central divisor pair is off diagonal:
  M_j-lambda_j=2q_j>2sqrt(T),
and
  lambda_j<sqrt(T+2(R-A_j)(R-B_j))-sqrt(T).

  gcd(H0,H1)=X,
  gcd(H0,H2)=Y,
  gcd(H1,H2)=E,
  gcd(H0,H1,H2)=1,
  H0H1H2=(abd0EXY)^2.

  Xi(P)=(G0,H0,H1,H2).
For fixed realized Xi,
  Cprod=G0/(ab)=c12c21.
There are at most tau(Cprod) ordered divisor splits. Each split fixes c21,c12,c,f,x,y and at most one q through (bc)^2+(af)^2=q^2. Then h|q gives at most tau(q) choices; g,e,z,R,U,V are forced/check-only. Since Cprod<=B^2 and q<=B,
  #Xi^{-1}(xi)=B^o(1)
uniformly.

For Xi_B^large(delta) with sf(G0)>B^(1/3-delta),
  #P_large(B;delta)<=B^o(1)#Xi_B^large(delta).
Thus #Xi_B^large<<B^(1/3-epsilon) with fixed epsilon>0 is sufficient.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229FY
NEAR-SATURATION / NEAR-DIAGONAL CORNER: ORIGINAL SAME-P COUNT, PLUS p≡1 mod8 MOD64 SCREEN NO-GAIN


CARD_DOC_ID=1oyApUgcUt4Shsriiv0Z85S7gvrjg2vQwpynjoLuVU0U
PREVIOUS_CURRENT=229FX; SOURCE_ROW_TO_APPEND=645; STATUS=PROVED_SCOPED_DERIVED_TOP_CORNER_o(B^(1/3))_RELATIVE_TO_EXISTING_346_UNIFORM_PER_p_INPUT / VERIFIED_MOD64_P1_NO_GAIN / BALANCED_GLOBAL_OPEN / FJ_FS_FW_FV_HOSTILE_AUDIT_HOLD / CREDIT0.
AUTHORITY=M3-T11-229; LATEST_CONSTRUCTION=M3-T11-228; M3-T11-230 NOT ISSUED; PRIMARY_GATE OPEN; GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT0; PRODUCTION HOLD; FORMAL_ROUTE_SWITCH NONE; CLOSURE UNCHANGED.


1. LIGHTWEIGHT AUTHORITY / RELEVANT PRIOR-ART AND ANTI-LOOP
Read MAIN latest229FX, canonical CARD-INDEX source row644 and live AI-00-CONTRACT, LEDGER head229FX, active ROUTE head229FX, card229FX, NEG head229FX. Targeted prior FJ229FJ, FM229FM, FR229FR, FS229FS, FV229FV and FW229FW summaries; AI-10 read-only search BALANCED_PRIME_SUPPORT, NO_GO, BILINEAR, SELECTOR_AWARE and source Y historical keywords. Prior FM shows O(1) r per fixed (p,q) leaves ~B^(2/3) candidate pair envelope, NOT o(B^(1/3)); prior FR exact p≡5 mod8 78 mod64 exclusions cannot simply extend to p≡1 mod8. Prior FS/FV/FW established, at their claimed scoped level, a uniform original same-P bound N_346(p;B)<=A exp(C logB/loglogB) for EACH moving least split prime p and 346 remaining genus-one code placements; their all-source/height independent hostile certification remains HOLD. Prior FX eliminated 68 degreezero placements under FJ414 completeness. No unweighted Gaussian virtual-source count is substituted.


2. FY.1 — EXACT COUNT OF A NATURAL THIN BALANCED TOP CORNER
Original source: positive primitive full-four-square P=(e,x,y,U,V,z,R) with R=pqr<=B, p<q<r distinct split primes, full same-P HIGH, sf(G0), Kcross/rad(Sd), q/Gres, 229EX restrictions retained as further filters; only the 346 FJ genus-one code source labels are relevant under FX/FJ classification. Write L=logB/loglogB (B sufficiently large) and let eps_B=exp(-K L), with K>C, where C is the existing claimed uniform per-p constant for N_346.


Define the genuine original subpopulation T_B(eps): P satisfying
    B(1-eps)<=R=pqr<=B,   1<r/p<=1+eps.
Because p<=q<=r<=p(1+eps), we have
    B(1-eps)<=pqr<=p^3(1+eps)^2
and also p^3<=pqr<=B. Hence every possible least prime p lies in the DETERMINISTIC integer interval
    [B^(1/3)*((1-eps)/(1+eps)^2)^(1/3), B^(1/3)].
For 0<eps<1/2, interval length <=c eps B^(1/3), with an absolute c (e.g. c=3 suffices for eps sufficiently small). It contains at most c eps B^(1/3)+1 integers, hence at most that many relevant split primes; no prime distribution or independence needed. By the RETAINED original same-P 346 bound at each p,
    #T_B(eps) <= A(c eps B^(1/3)+1) exp(C L)
        << B^(1/3) exp(-(K-C)L) + exp(C L)
        = o(B^(1/3))  for any fixed K>C.
The second term exp(C L)=B^o(1)=o(B^(1/3)). The result is a direct and rigorous COROLLARY CONDITIONAL UPON the actual uniform original same-P 346 count asserted by FS/FV/FW and the complete FJ/FX Gaussian source partition; it is not a new independent certification of those inputs. The theorem counts actual original P, not just admissible prime triples or ambient Gaussian slopes, and uses exactly one per-p source count with no artificial multiplication of filters.


Alternative coordinate-free form: letting delta_R=1-R/B and delta_D=r/p-1, the sector max(delta_R,delta_D)<=exp(-K L) is disposed at the same bound. It is a genuine previously untreated near-B near-equal corner of the balanced pqr window, DISJOINT from the low-least-p disposal when eps is sufficiently small. But it has vanishingly thin relative width exp(-K L), not an entire fixed-ratio dyadic box, and gives NO fixed-power gain over the balanced global remainder.


3. FY.2 — DIFFERENT ATTEMPTED METHOD, p≡1 mod8 MOD64 OBSTRUCTION TO LABEL PRUNING
Use FJ exact 13 Gaussian sign codes k in {-1,0,1}^3 modulo global sign, 138 admissible unordered triples (at most one zero in each prime coordinate), and three Pythagorean hypotenuse assignments: 414 configurations. For a=u²-v² odd and b=2uv divisible4, let t=b/a, X=T/S and Y=V0/U0 with even Gaussian numerators divisible4 and denominators odd. Put kappa=(b/4)mod2, xi=(X/4)mod2, eta=(Y/4)mod2. Squaring the seven FJ §3 macro leg normal forms modulo64 gives each normalized L_k²/16 modulo4 an elementary parity bit beta_k:
    beta_k = (|k_p| kappa + |k_q| xi + |k_r| eta) mod2,
since the relevant Gaussian signed numerators are multiples of4 and their squares mod64 are exactly 16 times parity, and 1+X²,1+Y²=1mod16. Thus the mod64 Pyth identity requires the ordinary integer bit equality beta_left+beta_right=beta_hyp (no wrapping, sum<=2).
For p≡5mod8, kappa=1; exact FJ 13/138/414 finite bit enumeration gives 78 assignments failing ALL four (xi,eta) parity choices, reproducing the CARDINALITY of FR's 78 (not claiming matching old lexicographic indices). For p≡1mod8, kappa=0; selecting xi=eta=0 gives all beta_k=0 simultaneously for EVERY one of 414 assignments, so this SAME coarse mod64 bit-test cannot exclude ANY class uniformly in p≡1mod8. This does NOT imply existence of a full physical point or a lift to primes; it proves only insufficiency of the four-bit local necessary screen. Exact independent enumerator: 13 codes, 138 triples, 414 assignments, no-gain p1 0 excluded, p5 78 excluded. This attempt was actually executed after prior-history check; no repeat of p5 claim as new global counting progress. Do not attempt larger moduli without adding new source-specific information: FR already saw mod128/256 no gain for p5 under its certificate.


4. LIMIT / STRATEGIC AUDIT AND NEXT
FY.1 saves a genuine original SAME-P thin top corner at the exact one-third target scale, beyond the earlier low-p cutoff, but is a DERIVED corollary and does not dispose any full balanced dyadic box with p~q~r~B^(1/3). FY.2 is a verified negative on p1 coarse mod64 support; not a reason to stop using other methods. The last five prior FX/FW/FV/FU/FT steps improved source arithmetic / low-p counts but did not close global balanced power budget. Primary alternative remains a real occupied (p,q) plus third r prime norm/discriminant bound with fixed-power or logarithmic aggregate gain, maintaining exact original q/Gres and HIGH signed selectors, or an actual UNIFORM AVERAGED elliptic point theorem reducing sum over all p<=B^(1/3) below one-third. Apply 229FM pair O(1) fiber firewall: ~B^(2/3) pair envelope demands additional factor ~B^(-1/3) absent. No product of independent local sieve factors, no ghost curves, no arbitrary pair support charged.


NEXT_EXECUTABLE: formulate and certify for every dyadic balanced p,q~B^(1/3) the occupied pair incidence
    sum_{p,q in balanced box} # {actual original P with these p,q and r split prime, R=pqr<=B, all selectors} = o(B^(1/3)),
using a B-sensitive biform discriminant / prime-norm correlation, not merely at-most-two roots in r per pair. Separately independently hostile-replay 414 source, all245 FS height maps, FW84 torsion certificate, FV16 lifts and FX eight/52 zero labels. Then omega(R)>=4 and repeated powers.
